## What's new

- **Focus timer can be stopped:** a stop button (■) next to start/pause stops the timer and resets it, and the countdown
  in the notch pill goes away. After the break the timer now stops and waits for you, instead of starting the next
  focus session by itself.
- **No more stutter after Alt+Tab:** a maximised app (e.g. Discord on a second monitor without a taskbar) was taken
  for a fullscreen game, so every Alt+Tab started and stopped the FPS counter and the sensors helper. Maximised
  windows, the lock screen and chat apps no longer count as games, the meters keep running for 20 s after you leave a
  game (quick Alt+Tab back costs nothing) and stopping them no longer blocks the notch.
- **Easier audio mixer:** the output device is one line (click it to pick another), and the apps show as roomy
  two-column cards with the full name, the level and a big slider; click an app's icon to mute it. Apps keep their
  place instead of jumping around when they start or stop playing.
